title: Imports, listed
description:
List what a program imports from each DLL, from a simple table.

```
KERNEL32.dll: CreateFileW, ReadFile, CloseHandle
USER32.dll:   MessageBoxW
d3d11.dll:    D3D11CreateDevice
5 functions from 3 DLLs; nothing from the network libraries
```
hints: `line.find('!')` splits the DLL from the function (lesson 9.03).
Upper-case the DLL names before using them as map keys.
requirements: Input: lines of `dll!function` (as a dump tool might print them).
Group by DLL with names sorted, ignoring the case of DLL names.
Point out imports that hint at what the program does (files, windows, network, registry).
stretch: Read the real import table of a program you compiled with the PE parsing from this milestone.
